jcr_content.jcr:title: Single Board Computer MBa93xxLA
jcr_content.jcr:description: The Embedded Single Board Computer MBa93xxLA is a powerful and versatile solution for embedded computer engineers seeking high-performance computing
jcr_content.keywords: Embedded Single Board Computer, SBC, TQMa93xxLA, i.MX 93, Cortex-A55, Machine Learning Accelerator, Gbit Ethernet, TSN, USB 2.0, WiFi, Mobile Network, Integrated Security, NXP, Embedded Computing

textwithimage.text:
Based on TQMa93xxLA as a platform with TSN Gigabit Ethernet, ML-Accelerator and Graphics support.

The Embedded Single Board Computer MBa93xxLA is a powerful and versatile solution for embedded computer engineers seeking high-performance computing capabilities in a compact form factor. This Single Board Computer (SBC) is built on the robust TQMa93xxLA platform, featuring the Arm Cortex-A55 processor from NXP, renowned for its reliability and efficiency in embedded applications.

One standout feature of this SBC is its Machine Learning Accelerator, delivering 0.5 TOPS (Trillion Operations Per Second). This capability empowers engineers to harness the power of machine learning for various applications, enhancing functionality and performance.

In terms of connectivity, the MBa93xxLA offers a comprehensive range of interfaces, including I2x CAN FD, Digital IN/OUT, and Analog Input. High-speed communication is facilitated through dual GbitEthernet ports, one of which supports TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking), ensuring precise and real-time data transmission. Additionally, the inclusion of 2x USB 2.0 interfaces, onboard WiFi, and Mobile Network support further enhances its connectivity options.

This SBC prioritizes security with integrated security functions, safeguarding critical data and applications. Moreover, its partnership with NXP Hardware ensures the reliability and quality associated with leading hardware providers.

With its compact design and extensive interface options, the Embedded Single Board Computer MBa93xxLA is a versatile solution suitable for a wide range of industrial applications, eliminating the need for custom designs and offering efficiency and flexibility to embedded computer engineers.

text.text:
Features

  • Arm Cortex-A55 Processor: Powered by the efficient Arm Cortex-A55 processor from NXP, providing reliable performance for embedded applications.
  • Machine Learning Accelerator: Offers 0.5 TOPS (Trillion Operations Per Second) for machine learning tasks, enhancing the SBC's capabilities.
  • Comprehensive Connectivity: Equipped with dual GbitEthernet ports, including one with TSN support, along with USB 2.0 interfaces, CAN FD, and various digital and analog input/output options.
  • Onboard Wireless: Includes WiFi and Mobile Network support, enabling wireless communication and connectivity.
  • Integrated Security: Features integrated security functions to safeguard sensitive data and applications
